title.narrative: UNICEF Malawi continued to strengthen systems for gender transformative programming across its development and humanitarian response. In addition, a total of 1,505 implementing partners and beneficiaries were sensitised on PSEA, reporting mechanisms and available Gender Based Violence (GBV) and sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) services. Approximately 13,000 UNICEF supported beneficiaries and community members were reached with SEA messages and have reported have access to the reporting channels, with 4,226 mentioning the reporting of SEA cases.
